本仪表盘由 GitHub Actions 定时工作流自动生成。它定期抓取 Hyp: Le dashibhodi yenziwa ngokuzenzekelayo yi-workflow yeshedyuli ye-GitHub Actions. Ihlala ifumana i-API yoluntu ye-Hypixel SkyBlock ize ithelekise impendulo nganye nesnapshot yangaphambili; iinkalo ezongeziweyo / ezicinyiweyo / ezitshintshiweyo zirekhodwa kuluhlu lweenguqu olungasentla ngendlela yokuphicotha ikhowudi. “Inguqulelo yangoku” ephezulu ephepheni ivela kwinkalo ye-version yee-endpoint ezimbini zemithombo, ii-collections nee-skills: kuba i-Hypixel ihlaziya ngamaqela, ezi endpoint zimbini azihlali zitshintsha ngaxeshanye, ngoko ke inguqulelo entsha iqinisekiswa kuphela xa iinguqulelo zazo zombini zifana; ukuba azifani, kugcinwa inguqulelo yokugqibela ezinzileyo kuze kuboniswe “Inguqulelo iyalungelelaniswa” ukuze inombolo yenguqulelo ingatshibi ngapha nangapha. Ukutshintsha kwenguqulelo kurekhodwa ngokwahlukileyo kwiphaneli “Imbali yeenguqulelo” kwaye akuxutywa noluhlu lweenguqu zomxholo we-endpoint; laa phaneli nayo igcina kuphela iintsuku ezingu-30 neerekhodi ezingama-20 ubuninzi. Ukuhla nenyuka kwamaxabiso e-bazaar kucociwe, kuphela ukongezwa nokucinywa kwesakhiwo sezinto okulandelwayo. I-endpoint yamapakethi emithombo (packs) ithatha inguqulelo enelona xabiso liphezulu le-packFormat (eli nani liyatshintsha xa i-MC ihlaziywa); xa i-hash esemthethweni itshintsha, i-zip iyakhutshelwa ize ivulwe, kwaye ukongezwa, ukucinywa nokutshintshwa kweefayili ezingaphakathi kwipakethi kuthelekiswa nge-hash yomxholo; iifayili zombhalo ezitshintshiweyo zibonisa kuphela icandelo elitshintshileyo ngombala obomvu noluhlaza, kwaye iifayili ezintsha ziphawulwa ngokuluhlaza kuphela. I-endpoint ye-Bingo (bingo) irekhoda ixesha lokupapashwa, lokuqala nelokuphela kwemisebenzi yomjikelo ngamnye ize idwelise yonke imisebenzi kwigridi engu-5×5 (ukusuka ekhohlo ukuya ekunene, ukusuka phezulu ukuya ezantsi; cofa iseli ukubona umbhalo opheleleyo); ukubala ukuhla kudlulisela ii-milliseconds ze-epoch ze-start / end kwibhrawza ukuze zibalwe nyani ngomzuzwana, ngoko ukulibaziseka kokufumana kwe-Actions akuchaphazeli; iikhowudi zemibala ye-Minecraft (§) kumbhalo wemisebenzi zibuyiselwa ngemibala esemthethweni, kwaye inkqubela yeseva yonke isetyenziselwa kuphela ukubonisa kwaye ayithathi nxaxheba kuthelekiso lweenguqu. I-endpoint yeentengiso (firesales) ifunwa ngokutsha ku-run ngamnye (urhulumente unokutshintsha ixesha/ubungakanani/ixabiso phambi kokuba intengiso iqale); umjikelo ngamnye unekhadi lawo elibonisa ixabiso nobungakanani, kwaye iqhosha “Bonisa idatha eyongezelelweyo” livula imijikelo yonke kunye ne-JSON ekrwada. Ukuba naluphi na ufumano lwe-endpoint okanye ukukhutshelwa kwepakethi yemithombo kuyasilela, le run ayiyi kutshintsha nayiphi na idatha kwirepository.
